items.text: The NIFTY 500 fell 0.6% on 13 Nov. Telecommunication was the strongest sector (+0.1%) and Power the weakest (−1.2%).

Foreign investors bought a net ₹8,884 Cr of Indian shares in the session reported on 13 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 42 niches. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Travel Services & Railways Catering and Large Private Banks.
